family.description: BBS5 is part of the BBSome complex that may function as a coat complex required for sorting of specific membrane proteins to the primary cilia [[cite:PUB00060532]]. Mutations in the BBS5 gene cause Bardet-Biedl syndrome 5 [[cite:PUB00073459],[cite:PUB00073460]]. This entry represents the second PH-like domain.
family.name: Bardet-Biedl syndrome 5 protein second PH-like domain
